instruction: Create a 'millennium_decade' sheet with my watched films from 2000 to 2010, arranged from A to Z by title.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click(640, 400); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new sheet 'millennium_decade' with movies from 2000-2010 (inclusive) sorted alphabetically by title. Verified with Python: 31 movies from this period, starting with '3 Idiots' and including classics like 'Batman Begins', 'Finding Nemo', 'Gladiator', etc. Evaluator checks header, year range (2000-2010 inclusive), alphabetical sorting, and count. Includes postconfig to save the file.
